verdicts.file: Castle Field and Castle Cottage, Sleaford - geograph.org.uk - 7876667.jpg
verdicts.note: Rough grassland with a mown green track, farm buildings with red roofs, greenhouses, hedges. Flat farmland, no masonry or earthwork; a different place (Sleaford), not Belbury.
Harvested wheat field with a verge of yellow and purple wildflowers and a distant treeline. No stone or bank visible; a field in another country, not Belbury.
Village green of mown grass with a row of stone cottages, chimneys, picnic tables and bare winter trees. No castle remains; another village, not Belbury.
Woodland edge with white-blossoming trees, birch and green undergrowth under blue sky. Only trees and scrub, no masonry or earthwork; not Belbury.
Cream rendered cottage beside a paved lane with a wooden fence and open sheds. An inhabited modern dwelling, no ruins; another place, not Belbury.

verdicts.file: Castle Field looking down the mound seen from Spofforth Castle (4th August 2018).jpg
verdicts.note: Broad sloping mown field in low evening light, village houses and an information board on the horizon. Even turf, no visible earthwork or stone; not Belbury.

verdicts.file: Kilmartin Carnasserie Castle field south of the castle.jpg
verdicts.note: A standing ruined stone tower with window openings and dry-stone walls before green hills and conifer plantations. A different castle ruin, not Belbury.
A large spreading tree in a meadow thick with yellow buttercups, hedgerow behind. No ruins or bank; a tree in a meadow at another place, not Belbury.

verdicts.file: Childrens Fun Fair, Castle Field, Southsea 1 - 53684516346.jpg
verdicts.note: Aerial view of a seafront funfair: rollercoaster, helter-skelter tower, carousels, striped big top, promenade and sea beyond. Modern scene, not Belbury.
Plain 20th-century brick and clad hall with a car park full of parked cars, a sign on the wall and one trimmed tree. Modern commercial scene, no ruins, not Belbury.
Cottage beside a narrow lane with a SLOW sign, wooden shed, picket fence and rolling hills behind. Rural dwelling, no ruins; not Belbury.
